recent_trades.summary: Exiting GE as negative aerospace sentiment intensifies — Honeywell Aerospace's standalone quarter was described as 'a mess' and GE still faces supply shortage headwinds, weakening the industrial aerospace recovery thesis.

Two negative signals: (1) Honeywell Aerospace's first standalone quarter was poorly received and signals broader aerospace sector pressure; (2) GE's own headline notes it is still talking less about an ongoing shortage. Negative sentiment at -0.18. The original thesis was aerospace recovery and defense spending — both are now clouded by supply chain constraints and peer weakness. Taking profits now is prudent.
